scope: Bounded alternative stress-virome feasibility audit; not systematic or exhaustive. Core scientific inputs unchanged.
raw_storage: Successful response snapshots and binary packages are local ignored cache; this tracked ledger preserves URLs, hashes, byte sizes, request failures and key findings for review in a fresh checkout.
conclusion: No screened alternative verified to provide public processed recipient viromes and directly measured immune observations with explicit individual-animal linkage. Chen2026 remains unresolved.

verified_findings: Viral metagenomics concerns piglet donor-source material pooled within six pre-weaning and six post-weaning piglets.
Mouse recipient microbial profiling is 16S bacterial amplicon sequencing at four stages, not recipient virome profiling.
Recipient colonic TNF-alpha, IL-6, IL-10 qRT-PCR are immune-related measurements; corticosterone and metabolites are separate outcome classes.
Correct DOCX has six supplementary figures, one aggregate power/effect-size table, six images and no embedded files.
PRJNA1250699 ENA report currently lists 46 AMPLICON records; broad repeated aliases do not supply recipient viral/immune linkage.
Individual mouse fecal viral metagenomics follows 21-day chronic restraint stress (control7,stress8).
Assays described are behavior, body weight and targeted fecal neurotransmitter metabolomics; no directly measured host immune assay was identified in full methods or correct supplement.
Correct 593069-byte DOCX contains two virome figures and one aggregate baseline SPT/FST/TST table; no embedded files.
PRJNA877780 ENA report lists15 WGS records.
BioStudies mirrored DOCX is content-mismatched and rejected; correct Europe PMC member recovered.

sections: Animals, treatments, and collection of fecal samples
verified_findings: Endpoint metagenomes from three individual rats in each of five stress/treatment groups; no serial recipient virome series.
Full assay methods report behavior/body weight and viral/bacterial computational profiling, without a directly measured host cytokine/immune-cell assay.
All eight authentic XLSXs recovered from Europe PMC package and inspected, including all worksheets.

Correct Table1 has15 sample QC rows (e.g. HC01), Table2 has5029 vOTU quality rows, Tables3-5 contain group-level CRISPR/tRNA/BLAST host links, Table6 aggregate host counts, Table7 25106 host assignments, Table8 157 virus-bacterial links.
Authentic eight tables contain no virus-by-individual-sample abundance matrix or individual mammalian immune observations.
Eight BioStudies mirrored XLSXs contain unrelated plant genetics and are rejected; mismatch cause not established.
PRJNA910226 independently linked by article XML and BioStudies; ENA metadata requests timed out and do not show deposit absence.
Official public preview and abstract identify prenatal-stress rat offspring virome/FVT and immune responses.
Public preview offers supporting data through corresponding author on reasonable request.
Full methods, supplement inventory, processed recipient abundance/immune data, individual identifiers and longitudinal pairing were not verified.
Direct publisher requests returned403 and Elsevier metadata API401; these are access failures, not evidence of scientific ineligibility or absence of all public data.

search_observation: Focused 2025-2026 searches identified Chen2026 as the main new relevant primary lead, alongside Choi/Ritz and reviews or other conditions. No exhaustive absence claim.
